note: Synthetic and illustrative. Same headline nDCG@10 win as met.json -- the point of this fixture is that one guardrail breach still turns it into a mission failure.

failure_cases.observation: candidate nDCG@10 of 0.271 falls below the popularity baseline's 0.298 for this segment -- personalization is a net tax on new users here.
failure_cases.hypothesis: fine-rank's multi-objective heads are all trained on interaction history; with fewer than 5 events the shared trunk has almost nothing to condition on and the value tree is combining noisy, poorly-calibrated predictions instead of falling back toward popularity.

failure_cases.observation: final nDCG@10 for these queries is close to the popularity baseline rather than the mission mean.
failure_cases.hypothesis: recall union is starved on rare-token queries, so fine-rank and the value tree are reordering a nearly-popularity-shaped candidate set with little to work with.
